title: “Not everyone who says to Me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter the kingdom… but the one who does the will of My Father.” — Matthew 7:21
paragraphs: “Not everyone who says to Me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter the kingdom… but the one who does the will of My Father.” — Matthew 7:21
CLOSE TO GOD ≠ SURRENDERED TO GOD

You can sit near the fire and still stay cold.
Proximity doesn’t change you—surrender does.

God isn’t asking for attendance.
He’s asking for permission.

Tonight, the question isn’t “Am I close?”
It’s “What am I still holding back?”

Quiet moment. Honest prayer.
“Lord, I release what I’ve been protecting.”
